name: Tithes And Offering
overview: Scripture teaches that tithes and offerings are sacred and belong to the Lord, as emphasized in Leviticus 27:30 where all tithes of the land are declared holy unto God. Believers are called to honor the Lord with their substance and firstfruits, reflecting a heart of obedience and trust (Proverbs 3:9). The practice of giving is linked to blessing and provision, with Malachi 3:10 promising abundant blessings for those who bring their tithes into the storehouse, while withholding can lead to poverty (Proverbs 11:24). Additionally, giving must be done with the right motives, not for public recognition but as an act of righteousness before God (Matthew 6:1).
